compiler_only_output.reason: Vector3's four-byte inline destructor, emitted as vague linkage because this TU odr-uses Vector3 as a local: func_ov065_02116364 builds five of them on the stack. No member of daYurei_Mucho_c has that type -- the trigger is what the TU touches, not what it stores. The cartridge owns the body at arm9:0x020072c0 (config/arm9/symbols.txt names _ZN7Vector3D1Ev there) and an enrolled source already reaches it, so this object's copy is a duplicate that production isolation discards.

The implicit destructor of the five-Vector3 aggregate func_ov065_02116364 builds on the stack. The legacy shard spelled it as an unnamed local class, which mwccarm mangles with a file-and-counter tag that moves whenever the file does; it is given a file-scope name here so the symbol this row licenses is stable. The four-byte body exists only in this object and has no ROM home anywhere -- no symbols.txt in config/ names it, the retail link discarded it, and the 23 licensed bodies reproduce the cartridge without it.
